tools.name: get_contact_info
tools.title: Get contact info
tools.description: Return Digitec Performance Center contact details: phone, WhatsApp, email, address, and website.

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List Digitec Performance Center services in Dubai. Optionally filter by category (general or mercedes) or a case-insensitive search string on the title.

category.description: Filter by service category. Defaults to all.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against the service title.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.title: List brands serviced
tools.description: List luxury and performance car brands serviced by Digitec Performance Center in Dubai.

tools.name: build_booking_link
tools.title: Build WhatsApp booking link
tools.description: Build a WhatsApp deep link to Digitec Performance Center with a prefilled booking message that includes the car and service context.

vehicle.description: Vehicle make and model, e.g. 'Mercedes C63 AMG 2020'.

service.description: Service the customer wants, e.g. 'Oil change' or 'AIRMATIC suspension fault'.

notes.description: Optional extra context like symptoms, mileage, or preferred date.
